LESSON: TRADITIONAL

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: FUN GAMES
Topic 13.1: Traditional

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Traditional. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when playing enjoy playing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify various traditional and modern games for performance 30 Lessons traditional and modern games games for enjoyment
2. perform various game for fun games in pairs, small groups and whole class. various traditional and modern games. playing materials.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify various traditional and modern games for performance 30 Lessons traditional and modern games games for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify various traditional and modern games for performance 30 Lessons traditional and modern games games for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. perform various game for fun games in pairs, small groups and whole class. various traditional and modern games. playing materials.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to perform various game for fun games in pairs, small groups and whole class. various traditional and modern games. playing materials. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Traditional.
2. Explain Traditional to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Traditional.
4. Show that you can: identify various traditional and modern games for performance 30 Lessons traditional and modern games games for enjoyment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Traditional. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when playing enjoy playing?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify various traditional and modern games for performance 30 Lessons traditional and modern games games for enjoyment
2. perform various game for fun games in pairs, small groups and whole class. various traditional and modern games. playing materials.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
